name: Mango Banana Dream Sorbet
desc: A dairy-free Ninja Creami sorbet where banana gives the mango a velvety texture.

source.evidence: Searched Ninja Creami mango banana sorbet recipes (Food Banjo, I Dream of Ice Cream, Detoxinista, Recipes From A Pantry); none use this fruit combination and gram ratio, which reads as the owner's own formula.

ingredients.raw: 250 g ripe mango chunks, fresh or thawed frozen
100 g apple juice, plus 1-2 tbsp for re-spinning
1 tbsp light corn syrup or honey (optional, for a smoother texture)

steps: Blend the mango, banana, pineapple (if using), 100 g apple juice, sugar, lemon juice and corn syrup until completely smooth and the sugar has dissolved, about 1 minute.
Refrigerate the mixture about 30 minutes until cold, then pour into a Ninja Creami pint container, no higher than the max fill line.
Lid the pint and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours, until solid.
Spin on the Sorbet setting. If it comes out crumbly, add 1-2 tbsp apple juice and Re-spin.

references.title: Ninja Creami Mango Sorbet
references.usedFor: blend then freeze at least 18 hours on a level surface, splash of liquid before a re-spin
